scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the ten-vertex Petersen graph only; no extension to generalized Petersen graphs is asserted.

The polynomial counts unlabeled nonempty color classes of ordinary class-domination colorings using open neighborhoods, not the stricter domination coloring in which every vertex must also dominate a class.
Literature priority remains provisional because unindexed historical enumerations may exist.
title: One optimum orbit and six real zeros for the Petersen class-domination partition polynomial
